name: Purpose
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly ordains all things according to His divine purpose, as He made everything for Himself and establishes a time and purpose for all under heaven. The LORD's counsel prevails over human plans, ensuring that His will stands firm despite the many devices in a man's heart. Believers are assured that God perfects what concerns them and will not abandon the works of His hands, while His Word accomplishes the purposes for which it is sent. Ultimately, the purpose of life is summarized in fearing God and keeping His commandments, which constitutes the whole duty of man.
